text:
Alex (InfoSec): Auditor follow-up: need evidence for RBAC removal (svc-collector lost cluster-admin) + KMS usage window + vuln triage notes for image CVE-2025-7777. Can we assemble?

Auditor Lee: We need commit + diff, deployment rollout proof, k8s audit slice showing no privileged ops after change, CloudTrail KMS events (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), and vuln ticket + remediation verification. Also chain-of-custody for the bundle.

Rina (Security Eng): Target cluster prod-eu-1, ns telemetry. I'll gather commit sha, Argo rollout id, and sign the bundle.

Tom (Infra): I'll pull audit logs from the log index for 2025-11-12T10:00Z to 2025-11-12T11:00Z and CloudTrail KMS events for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:9999:key/ffee-1234. Example commands I ran: `kubectl logs --selector=component=audit -n kube-system --since-time=2025-11-12T10:00:00Z | jq 'select(.user.username=="system:serviceaccount:telemetry:svc-collector")'` and `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:9999:key/ffee-1234 --start-time 2025-11-12T09:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-12T12:00:00Z`.

Marta - Compliance: Map to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12. Include retention proof and S3 put events for chain-of-custody.

Rina (Security Eng): Plan: create dir `evidence-3891002222/` with `commit-diff.txt`, `rollout.json`, `k8s-audit.json`, `cloudtrail-kms.json`, `vuln-triage.md`, `control-mapping.csv`. Tar+sha256 sign and upload to s3://redwood-audit/evidence-3891002222/ with SSE-KMS.

Tom (Infra): Uploaded. S3 put snippet: `{"eventName":"PutObject","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/infra-cicd"},"eventTime":"2025-11-12T13:05:12Z","requestParameters":{"bucketName":"redwood-audit","key":"evidence-3891002222/evidence.tgz"}}`

Rina (Security Eng): CloudTrail shows Decrypt by svc-collector at 2025-11-12T10:04:23Z and no Decrypts after 2025-11-12T10:18:00Z (post-change). I'll include event ids and a CSV summary.

Auditor Lee: Good. For vuln triage include TICKET-11700, internal tag cve-2025-7777, mitigation steps, rebuilt image digest, and scan results.

Rina (Security Eng): vuln-triage.md includes rebuild digest sha256:aa11bb..., patched dependency list, and CI scan output.

Alex (InfoSec): Actions: Rina produce signed bundle + mapping (due 2025-11-15), Tom attach raw logs and put events (done), Marta finalize control refs (due 2025-11-15). Auditor will review.

evidence-bot: job compliance/assemble completed, artifact sha256: d2d2f4...

Auditor Lee: Please provide presigned link (48h) and the sha256. We'll validate chain-of-custody and may request a short video walkthrough. Thanks.
